evidence: apps/office/src/sal/textenc/textcvt.test.ts#copies every byte to the same-numbered Unicode unit
semantic.justification: Both pinned sal/textenc/textcvt.cxx fallback procedures preserve the original buffer, source span, output capacity, flags, status and consumed-counter contracts. Writer and Calc consume the same original signatures; no convenience overload is added. Focused tests cover unsigned byte widening, low-byte truncation, both early error masks, destination exhaustion, explicit spans and empty input. Full rtl converter lifecycle and compiled upstream differential remain unverified. Native text-to-Unicode descriptor/context API now dispatches the existing source converters, retaining null handles, the pointer-one stateless sentinel, real UTF8/UTF7/ISCII/ISO-2022 contexts, reset behavior, native flag admission and missing-converter fallback. Four direct HTML/SvParser tests and one factory/streaming dispatch test exercise the new consumer. Context storage is released by GC; this is not native pointer/allocation ABI parity.
